## Description

not to be a pain but when vrchat had another update it messed with my mic activation threshold. I am a questie. so no it's not steam or anything. my headset is fine. my mic was fine. just after the update my voice is now barely being picked up. my mic activation threshold has never been moved. it has been on 5%. and apparently at times my friends can hear themselves.

## Reproduction Steps

maybe look into the coding. cause this happened after the update. before everything was fine.
